title: Harmonic Nodal Geometry, Zero-Curve Curvature, and the Transverse Integral Identity for Riemann's Xi-Function

Apply the universal Cauchy-Riemann arc-length equation d|R|/ds = sgn(L_1(f;tau))*|f'| along {I=0} and diagnose the two-mechanism dichotomy (boundary Laguerre violation vs interior critical point)
Compute zero-curve curvature kappa(gamma_k) = Xi''(gamma_k)/Xi'(gamma_k) (Csordas-Smith-Varga velocity), fourth-order jets c_quart(gamma_k), and rigorous mpmath.iv enclosures
Evaluate the Euler-Stirling right boundary d_Euler(t) > 1/2 in sigma > 1 and track nodal chambers across finite domains
Apply the canonical Transverse Integral Identity |Xi(t-i*d)|^2 = |Xi(t)|^2 + 2*int_0^d u*W_tilde(u,t) du and the Wigner kernel ratio F_int(2*d*y) = tanh(d*y)/(d*y) in (0,1)
